title: Design System: DepShield AI Signal Grid

display.purpose: Hero statements and decisive score verdicts only.

body.purpose: Readable explanations, navigation, and operational controls.

data.purpose: Versions, CVEs, scores, paths, timestamps, and machine-state labels.

motion.name: mechanical-fast
motion.purpose: Control state changes and one-pixel registration movement.

motion.name: scanline-hit
motion.purpose: Single-pass primary action feedback; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: profile-rotation
motion.purpose: Slow wireframe profile rotation while the visual is in view.

components.name: Primary Scan Button
components.description: The single high-signal action used to start a project scan.

components.name: Evidence Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action for comparison, filtering, and inspection.

components.name: Manifest Input
components.description: Hard-edged field for project paths and evidence filters.

components.name: Indexed Navigation
components.description: Persistent rail item with coordinate, icon slot, and active signal.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;background:var(--rail);border:1px solid var(--border)}.ds-nav-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;align-items:center;min-height:46px;padding:0 14px;border-left:2px solid transparent;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted-foreground);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav-item span{font:600 10px/1 var(--font-mono)}.ds-nav-item b{font:700 12px/1 var(--font-sans)}.ds-nav-item:hover{color:var(--foreground);background:var(--surface-active)}.ds-nav-active{border-left-color:var(--primary);color:var(--foreground)}.ds-nav-active span{color:var(--primary)}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Severity Tag
components.description: Rectangular severity label that never relies on color alone.

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Indexed telemetry card with one dominant persisted value.

components.name: Scan Status Strip
components.description: Compact machine telemetry for engine, advisory, ledger, and project state.
components.css: .ds-status{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);margin:0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:2px;background:var(--card)}.ds-status div{padding:12px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--border)}.ds-status div:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-status dt{color:var(--muted-foreground);font:600 9px/1.3 var(--font-mono);letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-status dd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--foreground);font:600 11px/1.2 var(--font-mono)}.ds-status i{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--primary)}

components.name: Dependency Evidence Row
components.description: Dense dependency record with classification rail and explicit remediation target.

narrative.overview: DepShield looks like evidence moving through a controlled forensic instrument. The interface is raw, digital, systematic, and intentionally flat: every rule, index, reticle, and status mark explains structure or machine state. It rejects soft SaaS cards and theatrical hacker glow while retaining enough quiet space for dense security evidence. The signature is a wireframe scan field that begins as a system-profile visualization and resolves into real dependency evidence. The hero may dramatize the mechanism; operational screens keep that language in registration marks, numbered sections, and compact telemetry.
keyCharacteristics: Hard-edged modular grids and 1px evidence dividers.
One sparse acid-green action signal against near-black surfaces.
Heavy grotesque headlines paired with monospace machine data.
Mechanical motion that stops for reduced-motion users.
Severity always communicated with text or an icon in addition to color.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Acid green should occupy less than ten percent of an operational viewport. Its rarity identifies the next action.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Color never communicates security state without a written label, number, or icon.

rules.name: The Case Discipline Rule
rules.body: All caps belongs to section coordinates and short system labels, never explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: A control may change fill or border on hover and focus; it never lifts off the canvas.

dos: Do let persisted scan evidence drive every metric, timestamp, path, and status.
Do use numbered sections and registration marks to clarify information architecture.
Do keep Attack Replay’s localhost-only and production-disabled warnings visible beside its action.
Do preserve stable data-ui hooks on operational regions.
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, ambient glow, or decorative shadows.
Don't soften the system with large radii, bubbly chips, or generic SaaS icon cards.
Don't animate essential content or ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't invent scan data, security claims, or provider status for visual effect.
